probe_method: Read-only HTTPS GET through the local HTTP proxy. GitHub REST API was returning HTTP 403 because the anonymous 60/hour rate limit was exhausted, so repository metadata was verified via public HTML pages and the public commits Atom feed; licence / dependency / source excerpts were fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com. Every URL, HTTP status, byte count and SHA-256 of the fetched body is recorded. No project was cloned, installed or executed on this machine.
limitations: Static inspection only: README, licence, dependency manifest and one entry-point source file per project.
No project was installed or run; 'works on this Windows machine' is NOT claimed.
A guessed source path that returns 404 is recorded honestly, not replaced with invented content.
Star counts / release versions were not read from the REST API; maintenance is estimated from the Atom feed timestamp.
